createMetadata.failedPack: Could not load this modpack’s versions.
createMetadata.emptyPack: No versions are available for this modpack.

memory.title: Out of memory
memory.reason: The JVM could not allocate the memory it needed.
memory.firstSuggestion: Adjust this instance’s memory limit and close programs that use a lot of memory.
memory.secondSuggestion: Use 64-bit Java and stay within the available physical memory.

java.title: Java version mismatch
java.reason: This Java version cannot read the game or mod bytecode.
java.firstSuggestion: Use automatic detection to select Java for this game version.
java.secondSuggestion: Check which Java major version the modpack and mods require.

mods.title: Mod dependencies or versions do not match
mods.reason: The loader reported missing dependencies or incompatible mods.
mods.firstSuggestion: Check the Minecraft and loader versions for your installed mods.
mods.secondSuggestion: Install required dependencies or disable recently added mods and try again.

graphics.title: Graphics initialization failed
graphics.reason: The game could not create the required graphics context.
graphics.firstSuggestion: Update the graphics driver and check OpenGL support.
graphics.secondSuggestion: On a laptop, try assigning Java to the dedicated GPU.

directory.title: Game directory access failed
directory.reason: A permissions problem or another process blocked file access.
directory.firstSuggestion: Choose a game directory writable by the current user.
directory.secondSuggestion: Close other game processes using the same instance directory.

unknown.title: Review the log for more details
unknown.reason: No common failure matched. The log excerpt is available below.
unknown.firstSuggestion: Look for Caused by and ERROR near the end of the log.
unknown.secondSuggestion: Back up the instance, then disable recently added content and try again.

empty.title: No logs yet
empty.reason: This game directory does not contain a log or crash report.
empty.firstSuggestion: Start the game once, then return here to analyze its log.
